ev.q: CDC examined reported ventilation improvement strategies among a nationally representative sample
Weighted percentages (with 95% CIs) of ventilation improvement strategies among K–12 public schools, including by locale and school poverty level, were estimated.

methods_quotes.q: Weighted percentages (with 95% CIs) of ventilation improvement strategies among K–12 public schools, including by locale and school poverty level, were estimated.
Chi-square tests were used to test for differences in the percentage of schools reporting each ventilation strategy by school-level characteristics

Respondents who indicated “no” or “don’t know” for each ventilation measure are combined and included in the denominator.
